limitations: BIQ version/provenance must be verified against this exact SAV before numeric advice is trusted.
Fields terrain_base and terrain_overlay are decoded but alignment to BIQ names needs cross-check against the actual game view.
Resources, bonus grassland, railroad multipliers, Golden Age and other yield modifiers are excluded.
Citizen assignment, corruption/waste, growth and worker action times are not verified.
Conditional road gain is not a worker order and is zero for cities if the tile is not worked.
No hidden resource identifiers or unexplored terrain are published.
